consequence.statement: For environments using AWS Route53, not-found errors encountered during deletion of DNS records are now detected correctly, where this error detection was previously faulty; the evidence does not state what symptom the faulty detection caused.
consequence.remediation: No operator action is indicated by the evidence; verify Route53 DNS record deletion/cleanup behaves as expected after upgrading.

assertion.statement: cert-manager 1.18.0 fixes its AWS Route53 error detection so that not-found errors returned during deletion of DNS records are now detected correctly.
